newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB to accept 40 pct of CWRS wheat in Q4 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: CWB to accept 40 pct of CWRS wheat in Q4 1996/97.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board on Tuesday said it would accept 40 percent of its delivery calls for all grades of Canada Western Red Spring (CWRS), Canada Prairie Spring Red (CPSR), Canada Prairie Spring White (CPSW) and No3 Canada Western Amber Durum (CWAD) wheat for the final quarter of the 1996/97 (Aug/July) crop year.
The CWB said it would accept 100 percent of all other wheat, durum and barley classes and grades.
Prairie farmers have until July 7 to cancel their fourth quarterly delivery contracts for those wheat classes and grades that the CWB will accept less than 100 percent of.

The CWB said in March it had to defer 1.5 million tonnes in wheat sales to the 1997/98 crop year due to a severe backlog in ocean vessels at Canada's Pacific ports that cost it at least C$15 million in demurrage fines.
